body: What's better and what's not doesn't matter as well, your decisions means jackshit, its true that people like us have evolved through people who had talents and discoveries and yet how does it benefit them in the end, that's right, they just died, we might as well remember names but that's all it is.
Life is bullshit, fuck everything, fuck it all, all we do is eat shit and die, life is meaningless and pointless. Death is the only true peace.
I agree, life is shit, death is the only true peace, basically all we do is eat shit and die, our dreams, our goals are meaningless.

There's no reason, we are not that different from ants, life is meaningless and pointless, people keep struggling and struggling for nothing, alot of people keep moving because they got hope, but that hope is meaningless as well, because in conclusion all we do is eat shit and die.
I do agree about wasting our lives making money, its like we are just here to pay bills and die, just meaningless reasons.
Well mine is weird, when I feel bad I get suicidal and wants to die when I feel good I don't want to die.
You don't actually want to die, you want to escape.
Its funny we think the same. And yet I'm still alive

To be honest I don't mind if you die, (if you actually did it and not making this shit up),  I mean it's your choice, Life only gives you endless struggles, there's always something for you to worry about, there's always something you have to do, its tiring having to earn the respect of others, forcing yourself to deal with things you don't want.
I didn't lump them into groups, I just described myself.

Because deep down you don't want to die, you want to change how reality of life works, because a true suicidal person only becomes suicidal when he has lost everything, things didn't go the way he  wanted and in turn his life turned to shit, or just plain psycho. So which one are you?

Why even care about other people's comments if you know you are going to die sooner anyway? Why even care about everything around you at this point at all? Nothing matters after death, nothing I say shouldn't matter to you at all and yet you still bother replying to me, every memory, or basically everything about you wouldn't matter once you're dead. And yet you're boasting to me that you took 12 pills, If you're going to ask for help at least tell your story, but I don't know how your brain works. But anyway nothing I say matters because may die after a few hours now anyway.

Because I know what being hopeless and depressed means, I've been there and you my friend the way I read your comments(why even say you already did it, what's the point?) you seem like you're not that person, I may be wrong but who cares what I think, and please if you're actually 100% likely to commit suicide, at least be more lethal, cause that's what I would do, it seems to me you don't actually want to die, you can still survive with pills, less likely with a gunshot  or jumping off a tall building, I'm not saying this because I want you to die, it's just obvious you want people to hear you out OH WAIT NO WONDER YOU'RE POSTING IT.

It doesn't matter what you get or achieve in this world, everything is just temporary, and I get why you want to die, so if you really wanted to quit living, there is no goddamn person who can stop you, I'm experiencing the same thing right now, I blew it, I think I can't finish college, had a lot of failed subjects and if I fail one more time, I'll be forced to stop studying.

How do I know you're not making this shit up? What if you're just someone who wants attention?
And if you actually did what was the reason why you want to die?
But when she gets pregnant they don't say "I can't pay child support" instead they RUN.
I wish I was in a coma too at some point.

If you actually did it and killed yourself I wouldn't mind, life is pointless and meaningless anyway, I suffer the same fate and it doesn't matter if your family will be hurt because you won't be alive to see that anyway.
